More good funding news to start the year.

Dr. Seby Jugl, a recently-minted research assistant professor in the POP department, has been awarded a 3-year [American Heart Association](#0) career development award. These are very prestigious grants and will allow Dr. Jugl, mentored by Dr. Smith and others in the [POP department](https://pop.pharmacy.ufl.edu), to pursue additional training and research evaluating the cardiovascular impacts of medical cannabis use. Please join me in congratulating Dr. Jugl.

This is the first AHA career development award received in the lab, following two prior AHA predoctoral awards to lab members.

The COP has a [nice write-up of Dr. Jugl's award](https://pop.pharmacy.ufl.edu/2026/05/12/sebastian-jugl-wins-an-american-heart-association-career-development-award/).
